name: Forsyth Library
description: Main academic library providing research resources, computer access, study spaces, and librarian support for all FHSU students and faculty.

name: Writing Center
description: Free peer tutoring and writing consultation services to help students develop writing skills and improve academic writing assignments.

name: Career Services
description: Career counseling, resume assistance, interview preparation, job search resources, and employer networking events for FHSU students.

name: Student Health Services
description: On-campus medical clinic providing healthcare services, wellness programs, immunizations, and health counseling for enrolled FHSU students.

name: Information Technology Services
description: Technical support for FHSU technology services, network access, software support, computer labs, and IT troubleshooting assistance.

name: Office of Student Affairs
description: Student life programs, orientation, leadership development, student conduct, and support services for the FHSU student community.

name: Academic Advising Center
description: Professional academic advising to help students plan course selection, major requirements, and academic success strategies.

name: Disability Services
description: Accommodations and support services for students with disabilities including testing accommodations, accessible facilities, and assistive technology.
